U.note: Classic tapered glass with chrome cap and hourglass base, wax stretches and merges convincingly and the heat/cooling interaction works.

V.note: Gorgeous warm glow and glass, but the wax quickly collapses into a pool and a cap-clump with very few blobs travelling.

W.note: Pixelated blocky wax edges, murky dark glass and one big lump that barely moves make it the weakest.

X.note: Amber liquid with red wax blobs, brass base with a switch and good glow, blobs drift and merge organically.

Y.note: Readable lava lamp with glowing magma blobs, but the vessel is plain and the base flat.

Z.note: Elegant purple lamp with fluted base and strong lighting, though the pink blobs are uniformly soft circles and the controls are tiny.
